who_pays: TheraPlas pays you on a Prepaid Visa Card (PaySign) — you're immediately compensated after each donation.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, weigh at least 110 lbs, be in good health, and bring a valid ID, SSN, and proof of address — then pass the screening and physical. Every visit re-screens you; failing means no donation and no pay.
work_available: TheraPlas operates just two centers — Newark and Elizabeth, New Jersey — so this only works if you're in that area. The campaign page advertising the new-donor offer was verified live 2026-09-23.
what_gets_accepted: Completed donations only — pass the day's health screening and finish the donation. The $70 rate applies to each of your first 5 donations.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The first visit takes 2-3 hours with screening and physical before any pay; return visits run about 90-180 minutes. A needle in your arm, twice-weekly trips, travel and waiting — all unpaid. Reviews suggest regular pay runs $37-$60 per visit in some periods, so confirm the current rate.
when_cash_arrives: Immediately after each donation onto your Prepaid Visa Card.
